inciNote: Canonical array splits 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' into entries #1 and #2; positions below are canonical-array positions (subtract 1 for the normalized list).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #3 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4 with refatting PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate #6, no second anionic/reset route and no reset intent - the C1 pattern.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: early Dimethicone #9 plus Amodimethicone #13, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #14, pearlizing Glycol Distearate #17, Panthenol #8, Hydrolyzed Keratin #7 and refatting PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate #6 - multiple complementary systems, the C2 pattern.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: depositionLoad moderate (Dimethicone #9, guar #14, Amodimethicone #13), persistence moderate (silicones), resetCapacity moderate (SLES/betaine). W1 sets silicone + cationic guar + late amodimethicone in an effective sulfate/betaine base without rich 2-in-1 architecture to moderate. Extra Hydrogenated Castor Oil #16 and late Apricot Kernel Oil #22 keep high plausible.
weightPotential.counterSignal: two silicones plus cationic plus additional lipids converge
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W1 analog; effective cleansing base; not a rich 2-in-1
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high requires a clearly rich architecture with limited reset; reset is moderate and lipids are late

focusPrimary.rationale: Moisture: '3% Panthenol-Feuchtigkeits-Komplex', 'Spendet langanhaltende Feuchtigkeit', 'Nährt'. Formula supports both directions (dual_supported): humectant/refatting Panthenol #8 and PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate #6 with silicone/guar deposition for moisture; Hydrolyzed Keratin #7 + Amodimethicone #13 + Dimethicone #9 as a damage-care cluster. Positioning breaks the tie toward moisture. 'Locken' is hair_texture, not a focus.

careDirection.limitation: no glycerin; humectant cluster rests on panthenol

focusPrimary.counterSignal: 'stärkt das Haar von innen' and keratin point to repair
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula dual_supported; moisture is the named complex and dominant claim -> moisture.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'stärkt von innen' and curl definition are outcomes of the same panthenol/deposition route (F2); no independent route with distinct positioning.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: no frequent/daily, reset or treatment trigger.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: 'Reinigt sanft die Kopfhaut' is mildness wording without a scalp condition (E2 does not qualify); ordinary formula with fragrance.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse ideal (C high). Ordinary target, no T6. T2: curl claims ignored. T4: W neighbor high would make fine not_suited (acceptable fit, ordinary target) and normal acceptable -> review_thickness_boundary for fine and normal; coarse stays ideal at W high.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular; cleansing neighbor none -> no I3.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 false ('Tiefenpflegende Formel' / 'Tiefenspülung' are care, not cleansing terms).

uncertainties: INCI canonical array contains a split artifact ('Aqua (Water' / 'Eau)'), shifting one-based positions by one; E3 prominence unaffected (no scalp gate tested).

W1 is a near-exact analog but this formula adds Hydrogenated Castor Oil and Apricot Kernel Oil; standard gives no guidance whether additional late lipids move a W1 product. Kept moderate with neighbor high.
D1 lexicon: 'Tiefen-' compounds that refer to care ('Tiefenpflegende', 'Tiefenspülung') are not listed exclusions; treated as non-matching because D1 lists only cleansing compounds.
